channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: UAE says it's intercepting Iranian missiles and drones
item.description: The UAE intercepted Iranian missiles and drones. Iran has not commented on the incident. Iran war live updates: UAE says it's intercepting Iranian missiles and drones ABC7 New York.

item.title: Two killed and many injured after car driven into crowd in German city of Leipzig
item.description: A car drove into a crowd in Leipzig, killing two and injuring many. A 33-year-old German citizen was detained. Two killed and many injured after car driven into crowd in German city of Leipzig.

item.title: Last-gasp Doku goal salvages City draw at Everton, but still a blow to title hopes
item.description: Jérémy Doku scored a last-minute goal for City in a draw at Everton. The result hurts City's title hopes. Last-gasp Doku goal salvages City draw at Everton, but still a blow to title hopes.

item.title: Putin announces 2-day ceasefire in Ukraine
item.description: Putin announced a 2-day ceasefire in Ukraine. The move is intended to facilitate Orthodox Christmas celebrations. Putin announces 2-day ceasefire in Ukraine NBC News.

item.title: Hormuz tensions push ceasefire to the brink as Trump threatens Iran
item.description: The US encouraged ships to pass through the Hormuz Strait despite Iran's control claims. Trump threatened Iran over the situation. US military says it is encouraging ships to pass through Hormuz Strait, but Iran says it is in full control of waterway.

item.title: Ukraine and Russia declare separate truces
item.description: Russia declared a temporary ceasefire in Ukraine from May 8-9 for Victory Day. Ukraine declared its own ceasefire, calling Russia's proposal not serious. Russia said it will declare a temporary ceasefire in Ukraine from May 8-9 for its Victory Day celebrations, while Ukraine said it will have its own ceasefire, calling Russia’s proposal “not serious.”.

item.title: Putin declares May 8-9 ceasefire for war commemoration, Zelenskiy announces his own ceasefire
item.description: Putin declared a May 8-9 ceasefire with Ukraine to mark the WWII anniversary. Putin declares May 8-9 ceasefire with Ukraine to mark WWII anniversary, agencies say Reuters. Putin declares May 8-9 ceasefire with Ukraine to mark WWII anniversary, Defence Ministry says Reuters.

item.title: Russia and Ukraine declare competing ceasefires
item.description: Russia declared a May 9 truce, while Ukraine claimed its adversary fears Ukrainian drones. Moscow's declaration of May 9 truce comes as Kyiv revels in its adversary's 'fear' of Ukrainian drones.

item.title: Why U.S. troops are stationed in Germany, and what happens if some leave
item.description: US troops are stationed in Germany, with potential moves elsewhere under discussion. NPR's Mary Louise Kelly talks with Jeff Rathke, president of the American-German Institute, about U. S. troops stationed in Germany, and what happens if President Trump moves some of them elsewhere.

item.title: Moscow rehearses V-Day parade marking WWII victory
item.description: Russia rehearsed its Victory Day parade and declared a ceasefire with Ukraine. Moscow rehearses V-Day parade marking WWII victory.

item.title: Trump Obsesses Over Ballroom as Iran War Ceasefire Unravels
item.description: A ceasefire in the Iran war is unraveling, amid other concerns. Trump Obsesses Over Ballroom as Iran War Ceasefire Unravels The Daily Beast.

item.title: UAE shoots down Iranian missiles for first time since ceasefire
item.description: The UAE shot down Iranian missiles for the first time since a ceasefire, marking a significant escalation in the region's tensions. Iran latest: UAE shoots down Iranian missiles for first time since ceasefire The Times.

item.title: Modi's party takes control of India's West Bengal in key state election
item.description: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party took control of West Bengal in a key state election, strengthening Modi's political position midway through his third term. The outcome is expected to strengthen Modi's political position midway through his third term.

item.title: Russia offers Ukraine May 8-9 ceasefire amid WWII anniversary, but threatens major reprisals in
item.description: Russia proposed a two-day ceasefire in Ukraine on May 8-9, amid World War II anniversary commemorations in Moscow. President Putin declared the truce unilaterally. President Putin has unilaterally declared a two-day truce amid commemorations of the end of World War II in Moscow.

item.title: The US fights to reopen the Strait of Hormuz as the UAE comes under attack in a test of Iran truce
item.description: The US military is working to reopen the Strait of Hormuz after the United Arab Emirates came under attack, testing a truce with Iran. The US is seeking to restore shipping through the strategic waterway.

item.title: Two killed, several injured after car hits bystanders in Germany’s Leipzig
item.description: A car crashed into bystanders in Leipzig, Germany, killing two people and injuring several others. The incident occurred in the city's main square. Two killed, several injured after car hits bystanders in Germany’s Leipzig.

item.title: Iran's Guards Release New Map Of Hormuz Strait Under Their Control
item.description: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps released a new map showing the Strait of Hormuz under its control. A spokesperson warned that any ship breaching Iran's regulations would be stopped by force.

item.title: Iran-US clash over alleged warship attack in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran claims its navy forced a US warship to retreat from the Strait of Hormuz. The US denied any clash occurred between the two navies. Iran claims its navy forced a US warship to turn back from the Strait of Hormuz as Washington denies any clash.

item.title: Mali junta leader names himself defence minister after predecessor killed
item.description: Mali's junta leader appointed himself defence minister after his predecessor, Sadio Camara, was killed. Camara died in a jihadist and separatist forces attack. Former Defence Minister Sadio Camara was killed in a massive offensive by combined jihadist and separatist forces.

item.title: 2 Dead, Several Injured After Car Rams Crowd In Germany's Leipzig
item.description: A car rammed into a crowd in Leipzig, Germany, killing two people and injuring at least 20 others, including two seriously. The incident occurred in the city's main square. At least two people were seriously injured while 20 others were more lightly hurt.
